external_control_pins: Derive names through the explicit per-lane terminal mapping, then bind full actual manifest/terminal SHA256 to the pinned root adoptions. Hafnian source controls derive from its authenticated writer SOURCE_GUARDS_FINAL pins. OriginalINITIAL pair uses root-supplied exact pins. Mode-only terminal rows never waive full external pin equality.
snapshot_shapes: Complete actual dictionary snapshots keyed by canonical relative paths: files have bytes/SHA256/mode; directories include dot and have mode/empty. Hafnian historical source guard has separate root mode and nonroot directory-name-to-mode dictionary, explicitly adapted after key/path/schema checks. Source manifest lists remain lists and are checked for duplicate paths, parent topology, exact counts and full row data before equality.
normalization: Validate JSON uniqueness, allowed row fields/types, byte/count/hash types, canonical paths, root/parent topology and mode representations. Compare complete rows/dictionaries only after validation; inventory order is not byte/mode/topology drift. Do not coerce whole unit buffers into digest strings or infer counts from digest length.
visible_text_rule: Concatenate all HTMLParser handle_data events, then collapse whitespace once. Preserve complete raw li unit buffers independently. First-anchor route/title checks and whole visible text arrays are separate from typed JSON and raw JSON object arrays.
new_attempt_policy: ONE saved/full-read passive invocation; first failure stops with original literal streams and complete before/closing guard files. No implicit retry or input repair.
